title: SG-8.4.5 Distinguish loading message from submit success feedback
summary: Loading and success status elements in ContributionSheet become distinguishable and tests target the right one
description: Context: ContributionSheet renders the submit success message, the history loading message and the empty history message all with role="status" (ContributionSheet.tsx L153, L154, L159). tests/contributionSuccessFeedback.test.tsx uses findByRole('status') and can match the wrong element. Desired behavior: each status element has its own test id and the success test targets the success element. Expected result: loading, empty and error/Retry unit tests pass against real code. Why: unambiguous, stable assertions.
acceptance_criteria: Given history is loading, when the sheet renders, then the loading message is found by test id contribution-history-loading and the success element is absent
Given a successful send, when submitted, then the success message is found by test id contribution-success
Given the loading, empty and error/Retry unit tests run with mocked client, then they all pass against the real ContributionSheet

preserve: Existing roles, message texts and ids

definition_of_done: Status elements distinguishable by test id
